signals.title: Plovdiv Fantasy Week
signals.reason: An open-air urban festival right in the city centre with daytime interactive creative workshops, games, and storytelling suited for young kids.
signals.note: Confirmed on focus-news.net and plovdiv-online.com for September 21–27, 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Land - Attractions Festival
signals.reason: Outdoor family carnival zone featuring gentle rides, games, and food stalls that a 4-year-old will love.
signals.note: Confirmed on trakia-plovdiv.bg and eventibg.com for September 25 – October 4, 2026.

signals.title: Kids Festival & Expo 2026 – PlayCity
signals.reason: Dedicated weekend children's expo packed with interactive play zones, creative activities, and toddler entertainment.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and fair.bg for September 26–27, 2026.

signals.title: Festival of the Hills (Фестивал на тепетата)
signals.reason: Outdoor community festival with active games, sports, and nature adventures specifically staged on Youth Hill for kids and families.
signals.note: Confirmed on tourismplovdiv.org and 24chasa.bg for September 26–27, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: 'Sick Carries Healthy' (Болен здрав носи)
signals.reason: A funny and engaging 45-minute Bulgarian folk fairytale staged with puppets, ideal morning entertainment for a 4-year-old.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and grabo.bg for September 27, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: 'Grandpa\'s Mitten' (Дядовата ръкавичка)
signals.reason: Classic woodland animal story staged for young children, easily paired with a visit to the nearby Island Park in Pazardzhik.
signals.note: Confirmed on kupibileti.bg for September 26, 2026 at Drama & Puppet Theatre Konstantin Velichkov.

signals.title: Autumn Craft Fair Plovdiv 2026 (Есенен панаир на занаятите)
signals.location: Rayko Daskalov Street (Little Main Street), Plovdiv
signals.reason: A pedestrian street festival with live craft demonstrations, musical instrument workshops, and kid-friendly open-air games.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and rzk-plovdiv.bg for October 1–4, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: 'What a Crocodile!' (Ама че крокодил!)
signals.reason: An imaginative puppet performance using live sand-art drawings integrated into the storytelling, perfectly captivating for a preschooler.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and grabo.bg for October 3, 2026.

signals.title: Children's Railway 'Banner of Peace'
signals.reason: A miniature operating passenger train taking a gentle, thrilling loop with tunnels and bridges through parkland, a proven hit for 4-year-olds.
signals.note: catalog evergreen

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.reason: Spacious, secure open-air grounds with real airplanes and helicopters where a preschooler can roam and run freely on green grass.
signals.note: catalog evergreen

signals.title: Lokomotiv Plovdiv vs. CSKA Sofia Football Match: Major Traffic Restrictions & Bus Detours
signals.location: Lokomotiv Stadium (Lauta Park) & surrounding streets (ul. Lev Tolstoy, ul. Prof. Tsvetan Lazarov, ul. Dimitar Rizov)
signals.reason: High-profile First League fixture will draw heavy crowds, heavy police deployment, and shut major transit arteries around Lauta Park, detouring buses #9, 10, 21, 25, 29, 66, and 99.
signals.note: Confirmed on sportal.bg and gol.bg for fixture on September 20, 2026.

signals.title: Emergency Water Outage & Bus Route Changes in Proslav District
signals.location: ul. Boris Petrov No. 16 area, Proslav District, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Urgent water main repairs will shut off water supply for the daytime and force route detours on five city bus lines (#6, 15, 24, 66, 222).
signals.note: Could not confirm scheduled outage or bus detours on vik-plovdiv.bg or plovdiv.bg.

signals.title: Wizz Air Expands Direct Plovdiv–London Flights to Daily Frequency
signals.reason: Major expansion of direct air connectivity from Plovdiv to London Luton, ramping up from 3 flights per week to daily flights, significantly improving travel logistics without needing Sofia airport.
signals.note: Factually refuted; Wizz Air officially denied plans to increase to daily flights as reported in marica.bg.

signals.title: Septicflesh Live in Concert
signals.location: Ancient Theatre of Plovdiv, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Internationally renowned Greek symphonic metal act performing with full orchestration in an ancient Roman amphitheatre; completely accessible in English/instrumental form.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and visitplovdiv.com for September 19, 2026.

signals.title: The Gathering Live in Concert
signals.location: Ancient Theatre of Plovdiv, 4 Tsar Ivaylo St, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Renowned Dutch atmospheric post-rock and progressive metal band performing in English at the Roman theatre under the Autumn Salon of the Arts.
signals.note: Confirmed on gathering.nl and eventim.bg for September 22, 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Fantasy Week 2026
signals.location: Stefan Stambolov Square & Fantasy Non-Museum, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Urban storytelling and interactive media festival featuring visual arts, comic exhibitions, gaming, and multimedia installations right in the town centre.
signals.note: Confirmed on focus-news.net and plovdiv-online.com for September 21–27, 2026.

signals.title: Beloslava & Rushi Live Open-Air Concert
signals.reason: Sophisticated neo-soul and quality pop collaboration in a scenic outdoor park cinema setting.
signals.note: Confirmed on bilet.bg and life.dir.bg for September 25, 2026.

signals.title: Festival of the Hills (Festival na Tepetata)
signals.location: Nebet Tepe, Sahat Tepe, Bunardzhika, and Youth Hill, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Inaugural city festival transforming all four landmark hills into open-air culture stages with open-air cinema on Nebet Tepe, classical/French acoustic sets on Bunardzhika, and jazz on Sahat Tepe.
signals.note: Confirmed on tourismplovdiv.org and 24chasa.bg for September 26–27, 2026.

signals.title: GuitArt Festival X (10th Anniversary International Guitar Festival)
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture & Central Plovdiv Venues
signals.reason: Major international guitar festival bringing world-class virtuosic performers across classical, jazz, and fingerstyle disciplines; purely instrumental music with zero language barrier.
signals.note: Confirmed on guitart.bg and plovdiv-online.com for October 1–4, 2026.

signals.title: LUCKY House of Cinema (Dom na Kinoto Plovdiv)
signals.location: 1 William Gladstone St (Dom na Tehnikata), Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: The city's dedicated arthouse and festival cinema, consistently showing European, indie, and international cinema in original languages with subtitles rather than dubbing.
signals.note: catalog evergreen
